# Check for missing values in the GHG_value column and impute the mean of the non-missing values
data['GHG_value'] = data['GHG_value'].fillna(data['GHG_value'].mean())

neighbors_count = {}

    if row['neighbor'] not in neighbors_count:

    neighbor_index = df.index[df['borough'] == row['neighbor']].values[0]
    adjacency_matrix[borough_index, neighbor_index] = 1
    adjacency_matrix[neighbor_index, borough_index] = 1
